Stop a conversational AI agent stop-agent POST /v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/leave Stop a conversational AI agent Stops the specified conversational agent instance and causes the agent to exit the RTC channel. Authorization header When sending an HTTP request, you need to choose one of the following authentication methods:
  1. ** (Recommended) Use RTC Token**: Fill in the `Authorization` field with the RTC Token used by the Agora conversational AI engine project. You can choose the following methods to obtain Token:
    • In the test environment, you can generate a temporary Token (valid for 24 hours) for your project from [Shengwang Console](https://console.shengwang.cn/).
    • In a production environment, you can refer to [Using Token Authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/android/basic-features/token-authentication) to deploy the Token server to generate Token.
    Example of passing parameters: `Authorization: agora token="007abcxxxxxxx123"`
  2. **Use Basic Auth**: Refer to [Implementing HTTP security authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/user-guides/http-basic-auth#Use-http-basic authentication) to generate the Base64-encoded `Authorization` field.
    Parameter passing example: `Authorization: Basic NDI1OTQ3N2I4MzYy...YwZjA=`
appid path [App ID](http://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/get-started/enable-service#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id) used by your project. agentId path Agent instance ID, which is the unique identifier of the agent. After calling [POST to create a conversational agent](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent) successfully, it will be obtained in the response package body. 200

Retrieve a list of agents get-agent-list GET /v2/projects/{appid}/agents Retrieve a list of agents Retrieve a list of agents that match specified criteria. > This interface only supports querying the list of agents created within the last 7 days. Authorization header When sending an HTTP request, you need to choose one of the following authentication methods:
  1. ** (Recommended) Use RTC Token**: Fill in the `Authorization` field with the RTC Token used by the Agora conversational AI engine project. You can choose the following methods to obtain Token:
    • In the test environment, you can generate a temporary Token (valid for 24 hours) for your project from [Shengwang Console](https://console.shengwang.cn/).
    • In a production environment, you can refer to [Using Token Authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/android/basic-features/token-authentication) to deploy the Token server to generate Token.
    Example of passing parameters: `Authorization: agora token="007abcxxxxxxx123"`
  2. **Use Basic Auth**: Refer to [Implementing HTTP security authentication](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/user-guides/http-basic-auth#Use-http-basic authentication) to generate the Base64-encoded `Authorization` field.
    Parameter passing example: `Authorization: Basic NDI1OTQ3N2I4MzYy...YwZjA=`
appid path [App ID](http://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/get-started/enable-service#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id) used by your project. channel query Query the list of agents under the specified channel name. from_time query Query list start timestamp (s), default is 1 day ago. to_time query Query list end timestamp (s), default is the current time. state query Specify the status of the agent to be queried. A single query does not support specifying multiple states:
  • `IDLE` (0): Agent in idle state.
  • `STARTING` (1): The agent being started.
  • `RUNNING` (2): Running agent.
  • `STOPPING` (3): Stopping agent.
  • `STOPPED` (4): Agent that has completed exit.
  • `RECOVERING` (5): The recovering agent.
  • `FAILED` (6): Agent that failed to execute.
    • limit query Paginate to obtain the maximum number of items returned at a time. cursor query The paging cursor is the `agent_id` of the starting position of paging. 200

Broadcast a message using TTS
agent-speak
POST
/v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/speak
Broadcast a message using TTS
Let the specified agent broadcast a custom message.

During the conversation with the agent, calling this interface allows the agent to use the TTS module to immediately broadcast a custom message. After the agent receives the request, the broadcast behavior will interrupt the current speaking and thinking process.
text
priority
interruptable
200

Interrupt the agent
agent-interrupt
POST
/v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/interrupt
Interrupt the agent
Interrupt the specified agent from speaking or thinking.
default

Send a custom instruction
agent-think
POST
/v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/think
Send a custom instruction
Send a custom text command to the specified agent.

The interface will inject incoming text as user input into the current conversation link, and the conversational AI engine will continue to reason and respond according to the processing logic of ordinary user input. You can use this interface to implement scenarios such as implicit command injection, client-side event triggering, and voice and text collaboration.

Retrieve agent history
get-history
GET
/v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/history
Retrieve agent history
Capture the short-term memory of the conversation between the user and the agent.
You can call this API during the running of the agent (`RUNNING`) to obtain the short-term memory information stored until the creation of the agent, including:
- timestamps when the agent was created and stopped
- User and agent conversation messages
default

停止对话式智能体 stop-agent POST /v2/projects/{appid}/agents/{agentId}/leave 停止对话式智能体 停止指定的对话式智能体实例，并让智能体退出 RTC 频道。 Authorization header 发送 HTTP 请求时，你需要从以下鉴权方式中任选其一：
  1. **（推荐）使用 RTC Token**：将用于声网对话式 AI 引擎项目使用的 RTC Token 填入 `Authorization` 字段。你可以选择以下方式获取 Token：
    • 测试环境下，你可以从[声网控制台](https://console.shengwang.cn/)为你的项目生成临时 Token（有效期为 24 小时）。
    • 生产环境下，你可以参考[使用 Token 鉴权](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/android/basic-features/token-authentication)部署 Token 服务器以生成 Token。
    传参示例：`Authorization: agora token="007abcxxxxxxx123"`
  2. **使用 Basic Auth**：参考[实现 HTTP 安全认证](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/user-guides/http-basic-auth#使用-http-基本认证)生成 Base64 编码的 `Authorization` 字段。
    传参示例：`Authorization: Basic NDI1OTQ3N2I4MzYy...YwZjA=`
appid path 你的项目使用的 [App ID](http://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/get-started/enable-service#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id)。 agentId path 智能体实例 ID，即智能体的唯一标识。调用 [POST 创建对话式智能体](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/convoai/operations/start-agent) 成功后在响应包体中获取。 200

  1. **（推荐）使用 RTC Token**：将用于声网对话式 AI 引擎项目使用的 RTC Token 填入 `Authorization` 字段。你可以选择以下方式获取 Token：
    • 测试环境下，你可以从[声网控制台](https://console.shengwang.cn/)为你的项目生成临时 Token（有效期为 24 小时）。
    • 生产环境下，你可以参考[使用 Token 鉴权](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/rtc/android/basic-features/token-authentication)部署 Token 服务器以生成 Token。
    传参示例：`Authorization: agora token="007abcxxxxxxx123"`
  2. **使用 Basic Auth**：参考[实现 HTTP 安全认证](https://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/user-guides/http-basic-auth#使用-http-基本认证)生成 Base64 编码的 `Authorization` 字段。
    传参示例：`Authorization: Basic NDI1OTQ3N2I4MzYy...YwZjA=`
appid path 你的项目使用的 [App ID](http://doc.shengwang.cn/doc/convoai/restful/get-started/enable-service#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96-app-id)。 channel query 查询指定频道名下的智能体列表。 from_time query 查询列表开始时间戳 (s)，默认为 1 天前。 to_time query 查询列表结束时间戳 (s)，默认为当前时刻。 state query 指定需要查询智能体的状态，单次查询不支持指定多种状态：
  • `IDLE` (0)：空闲状态的智能体。
  • `STARTING` (1)：正在启动的智能体。
  • `RUNNING` (2)：正在运行的智能体。
  • `STOPPING` (3)：正在停止的智能体。
  • `STOPPED` (4)：已完成退出的智能体。
  • `RECOVERING` (5)：正在恢复的智能体。
  • `FAILED` (6)：执行失败的智能体。
    • limit query 分页获取单次返回的最大条数。 cursor query 分页游标，即分页起始位置的 `agent_id`。 200
